meta.title: Memory
meta.description: Keep your memory in every session: point it at a memory folder and it reads a few sections out of your markdown, injecting them once so they stay in context. Ships with a starter folder and file.

config.memoryDir: Your memory folder. Created with a starter file on first run, so this can be left alone; point it at notes you already keep to reuse them.
config.sections: Which sections to keep visible. A bare heading is enough; the default lifts the `常被提起` section.
config.maxChars: Default character budget per section. 600 characters is roughly 400 tokens, once per session.
config.header: First line of the injected block. It arrives as a user message, so it must not read like something the human just said.
config.refreshIntervalMs: Minimum milliseconds between injections in one session. 0 injects once.
config.refreshAfterMessages: Re-inject after this many new messages. 0 never re-injects.
config.workspaceRelative: Resolve a relative memory folder against the session workspace. Off means the process directory.
